jobs_results.title: Sr Cloud Infrastructure (DevOps)
jobs_results.description:
The Company:
You will get the opportunity to join a fast-growing company, modest enough for you to play a meaningful role and influence our technology and ways of working, but broad enough to make a change working towards long-term goals in an agile environment. The platform we build automates the insights-gathering process so that companies can gain access to insights faster with unparalleled scale.
You will be someone that shares our values and ambitions and can bring something to the team that we can benefit from. It might be a prior experience of the journey, architectural insight into cloud-native systems, specific technical expertise in parts of our stack or a combination of them all. Whatever it is, you will be the kind of person that is energized by complex challenges, teamwork and problem-solving.

Your Day-to-Day:
• Work as part of the infrastructure team on sprints that evolve our core platform and systems
• Provide point of expertise on infrastructure and CI/CD to our... wider engineering teams - often working as part of their scrum on larger projects
• Automate the build and deployment of software to our cloud platform and help the organization do it more efficiently and effectively. Eliminate all repetitive manual operations from our daily lives
• Improve our monitoring and alerting systems to enable engineering teams to successfully operate and gain insights into the behavior of applications in “hands-off” environments
• Participate in an on-call rotation and assist with troubleshooting issues that arise
• You will be a key person for the development organization by collecting and communicating the overall picture that will enable the teams to achieve better results

What you need:
• You have experience in predominantly cloud infrastructure roles (AWS) working within teams that practice DevOps
• You can interact comfortably with AWS via CLI and/or API
• You have expertise and solid experience in deploying infrastructure as code with, at minimum, Terraform and ideally some of the supporting cast (Ansible, Packer)
• You have excellent knowledge of building and running Docker images/containers
• You have excellent knowledge and understanding of the software development lifecycle, including the use of git and continuous integration tools (Jenkins’ Groovy DSL, TravisCI, github actions etc.)
• You have a grasp of “cloud native” and 12-Factor applications
• You have good knowledge of monitoring and alerting using one or more of: Graphite, Statsd, Prometheus, Grafana, PagerDuty
• You have expertise in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Bash, Ruby, Node, Golang, Java)

Nice to haves:
• You have good knowledge of the network stack at L4 and L7, particularly inter-VPC routing
• You have some experience with managing DNS and resolver hierarchies
• You can debug HTTP APIs and understand other L7 protocols
• You have experience administering Kubernetes
• You have specific cloud security expertise (threat assessment, attack surface management, SGs, NACLs, data security)
• You have experience in building and running Windows servers in AWS
• You have experience with continuous deployment strategies and technologies (Blue/Green, DNS or LB weighting, automated regression testing, Spinnaker, CodeDeploy, Jenkins for CD)

Benefits:
• Advantage of working in a large, stable, and reliable company, which managed to keep a dynamic and friendly work environment.
• Experience in international projects for first-rate global companies.
• Attractive salary and compensation package (advanced health insurance, dental, gym, ticket restaurant etc.)
• Company-sponsored professional training and certifications.
• Career growth and opportunities for development

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer | Azure
jobs_results.description:
Be a pioneer!

We want to extend our engineering capabilities and utilize DevOps tools and methods to automate testing and integration processes. That's why we are starting to build a DevOps team and you may become it's first member.

This gives you a unique opportunity to shape a long-term DevOps strategy, define processes, implement tools and guide young an aspiring engineers, using state of the art resources. For this, you work directly with our CTO and are integrated into our product development team of 20 engineers.

Benefits
• Permanent contract with a competitive salary.
• Yearly reviews, target agreements & salary increase.
• Private health insurance, paid trainings, team events and other benefits.
• Work in a modern and agile environment with state-of-the-art tools.
• Work partially or completely at home or at any other suitable place.
• Be part of a multi-cultural, talented, and ambitious team.
• Take advantage of career opportunities in a growing company.

Your Role
•... Design DevOps strategies, methods and workflows.
• Select and implement devops tools and resources.
• Provide knowledge and tools to other engineers.
• Contribute to improving efficiency and security.
• Set up metrics to measure our DevOps efforts.

Your Skills
• Extensive professional experience as a DevOps engineer.
• Profound knowledge of the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.
• Preferably good knowledge of security and data protection.
• Eager to take responsibility in an agile and challenging team.
• Fluent in English, both spoken and written (B2+).

About us

For over 25 years, hundreds of companies at thousands of locations all over Europe rely on our ever-evolving solutions and platforms to integrate their infrastructure, connect with their business partners, and transform and exchange their data. We process millions of business-critical documents each year – like orders, invoices, product catalogues, inventory, and price data.

Our next big leap is to build a unique Business Intelligence and Automation Platform. We call it FXM – Feedback & Experience Management. It utilizes vast amounts of industry data to provide real-time and easy-to-use reports for business leaders. This enables them to get unique insights and make critical business decisions putting them ahead of their competition.

Visit career.integrated-worlds.com to learn more. We look forward to meeting you

jobs_results.title: Devops Engineer
jobs_results.description:
THE WORLD OF UBISOFT

Ubisoft's 20,000 team members, working across more than 30 countries around the world, are bound by a common mission to enrich players' lives with original and memorable gaming experiences. Their commitment and talent have brought to life many acclaimed franchises such as Assassin's Creed, Far Cry, Watch Dogs, Just Dance, Rainbow Six, and many more to come. Ubisoft is an equal opportunity employer that believes diverse backgrounds and perspectives are key to creating worlds where both players and teams can thrive and express themselves. If you are excited about solving game-changing challenges, cutting edge technologies and pushing the boundaries of entertainment, we invite you to join our journey and help us create the unknown.

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile brings together dedicated and experienced professionals that are focused on crafting high-quality F2P games for mobile. We strongly believe in the core values at the centre of our Ubilife, which encourage us to... take ownership of our work, continually striving for excellence while promoting the sharing of knowledge across individuals and teams, without losing our sense of enjoyment and fun, while taking care for one another. We strive for a safe and respectful workplace for all team members and we're transparent about the measures we are taking to do so. For this reason, Ubisoft's Code of Conduct has been released publicly on our corporate website for all current and future team members.

Do you want to join us in the world of mobile gaming? If so, read on!

Job Description

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURE

We're currently seeking a DevOps Engineer to help our team on their next adventure. You will join an international and successful team and will report to the Tech Lead.

Your daily adventure:

• Administrate our cloud infrastructure in AWS and private cloud. Suggest improvements to the current setup.

• Provide technical guidance and educate team members on best practices in operations.

• Monitor metrics, provide observability to our infrastructure components and perform security audits.

• Define how to automate processes as well as deployment tasks. Own the deployment process to both internal and production environments.

• Set up CI/CD pipelines and educate the development teams to enforce a DevOps transformation.

• Update the DevOps processes for environment management including infrastructure, platform, and application lifecycle.

• Develop and document administration standards and procedures for internal and first-line support operations.

• Periodically offer round-the-clock third-line support of the production environments, as part of a rotating on-call duty.

Qualifications

YOUR SKILLS

Are you serious about fun? Do you consistently seek out learning opportunities and aim to beat your high score? Are you open to new ideas, perspectives and cultures and believe that it takes a world to build a world? At Ubisoft, you'll work alongside passionate and talented teams who are imagining the future of entertainment.

• 2+ years' experience as DevOps or equivalent.

• Strong experience with Linux-based infrastructures and AWS Cloud.

• Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code best practices and tooling like Terraform.

• Docker and Kubernetes knowledge is a must.

• Experience with infrastructure automation.

• Experience with operations in a microservices architecture.

• Experience with CI/CD tools.

• Knowledge of Groovy and Bash.

• Be a team player: we use agile development methods, where the team members are in permanent contact. Open mind and good communication skills are a must.

• Attention to detail, meticulous and organized working habits. Ability to multi-task and to adapt easily to change.

• Should be open for on call duty.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

• Work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is a must.

Bonus:

• Knowledge of Configuration as Code best practices.

• Knowledge of other Cloud providers like GCP or Azure is a plus.

• Knowledge of Python is a plus.

• Passion for games and some knowledge of the games industry.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Math, or related field. Master's degree in any of these disciplines is a plus.

• Spanish or Catalan is a plus.

Note: Posting is subject to change so please refer to career site for latest availability (SBJ-G337

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
¿Qué hacemos?

En FS Consulting – Microsoft Group asesoramos a las Entidades Financieras y Compañías Aseguradoras en la definición de su estrategia tecnológica con soluciones de Microsoft en cuatro ámbitos principales - Business Aplications (Dynamics y Power Platform), Data & AI (Machine Learning, Data Science, Power BI), Cloud (Azure) y Workplace (M365). Colaboramos en la selección e implantación de soluciones tecnológicas de Microsoft que permiten a nuestros clientes acelerar en su transformación digital, actuando cómo su "trusted-advisor" y colaborando de forma conjunta para alcanzar el éxito en todos sus retos. Nuestra misión: Ayudar a nuestros clientes a maximizar y aprovechar las capacidades de las tecnologias y soluciones de Microsoft.

Actualmente, ampliamos el equipo con un/a DevOps Engineer.

¿Qué podrás hacer?
• Participar en proyectos tecnológicos de primer nivel dentro de la plataforma de MSFT.
• Desarrollar tu carrera profesional en un equipo de trabajo multidisciplinar... y asumir retos apasionantes.
• Gestionar la solución final del cliente, revisando sus procesos y aportando valor en base a las mejores prácticas de la herramienta.
• Compartir espacio con una comunidad de excelentes profesionales dentro del ámbito de Microsoft en KPMG.
• Formación contínua y certificacionesv Microsoft.
• Participación y acceso a eventos de la comunidad y de Microsoft.

¿Qué necesitas saber?
• Al menos cinco años de experiencia en proyectos de DevOps (Azure principalmente).
• Desarrollo de estrategia de DevOps: Colaborar con nuestro cliente para desarrollar y perfeccionar la estrategia de DevOps de la organización, definiendo metas, objetivos y métricas de éxito. Evaluar el estado actual de las prácticas de DevOps e identificar áreas de mejora.
• Integración continua e implementación continua (CI/CD): Diseño, implementación y administración de canalizaciones de CI/CD mediante Azure DevOps Services o Azure DevOps Server. Definición de procesos de compilación y lanzamiento, automatización de pruebas e implementación de aplicaciones en entornos de Azure.
• Infraestructura como código (IaC): Automatización de la infraestructura utilizando herramientas como plantillas de Azure Resource Manager (ARM), Terraform o Azure DevTest Labs. Definición de configuraciones de infraestructura como código para el aprovisionamiento y la administración automatizada de recursos de Azure.
• Monitorización y registro: Conocimiento de herramientas de registro como Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics y Azure Application Insights. Configuración de soluciones de supervisión para realizar un seguimiento del rendimiento, la disponibilidad y el estado de los recursos y aplicaciones de Azure.
• Seguridad y cumplimiento: Implementación de prácticas recomendadas de seguridad para entornos de Azure, incluidos IAM, seguridad de red, cifrado y estándares de cumplimiento como GDPR, HIPAA y SOC. Asegurar que los procesos y la infraestructura de DevOps estén diseñados e implementados teniendo en cuenta la seguridad (DevSecOps).
• Conocimiento de lenguajes cómo PowerShell, Python, or Bash para automatización de tareas y gestión de recursos de Azure.
• Capacidad analítica y excelente nivel de interlocución con cliente.
• Nivel alto de inglés.
• Certificaciones a nivel Azure

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer (full remote / hybrid)
jobs_results.description:
Based in Barcelona, Qustodio is a fast-growing internet safety startup whose mission is to provide a safe digital experience for every child. Our top product is a multi-platform parental control solution that is used and loved by hundreds of thousands of families worldwide, and is one of the leading brands worldwide in the Digital Wellbeing category.

Qustodio is growing and we have some amazing challenges to face. From our Operation Team, we provide service to hundreds of thousand of users all around the world. We have an already well established and high performance platform that provides high availability and to our users. At this point of our evolution, we are looking to add a new member to our operations team that helps us to keep improving our platform and to keep improving pipelines and procedures.

What is our mission as a team?

The platform team is aimed to keep evolving our infrastructure providing the technological infrastructure for bringing our customers the greatest... experience. We are encourage to modernize our well established system to be more flexible, stand on high quality standards and help teams to bring features and improvements faster.

So, if you:
• Have experience managing orchestrated environments like Kubernetes
• Knows about Helm charts and knows how to craft them
• Care about quality and like to get things done the right way
• Have a comprehensive knowledge on networking
• Feel the need of having ownership on challenges
• Have expertise with the AWS services ecosystem
• Are interested in making things agile: by understanding and applying automation

What can we offer you:
• Great culture - friendly and emphasises both teamwork and fun.
• Our company is home to over 15 nationalities.
• Flexible working hours - and there are possibilities to work from home.
• Interesting challenges in a fast-growing technology company for you to grind your skills.
• Competitive salary range.
• Private health insurance.
• In-house training and team building events.
• A modern and fully equipped office headquarters in Barcelona city center,
• Daily fruit and beverages supply.
• Daily catering for lunch.
• 23 days of holidays per year. Half day off on your b'day.
• Flexible benefits

jobs_results.title: Cloud Engineer/DevOps
jobs_results.description:
• Come join a creative team dedicated to improving football performance by combining cutting-edge technology with top football minds!
• Kognia Sports Intelligence is seeking a Cloud Engineer to help us build and maintain infrastructure, foster a DevOps mindset across the organization, and work closely with other engineering and research teams. You will have an opportunity to make a huge impact while collaborating with talented software engineers, data scientists, and more. The salary range is EUR 40.000-55.000 annual plus bonus, commensurate with experience. We are looking for someone capable to learn on the job but also able to contribute from the beginning, minimum 1 year in a similar position or 3 years in other engineering roles with relevant responsibilities.

Kognia Sports Intelligence

We are a young Barcelona-based startup funded by football industry leaders including superstars Xavi Hernández and Iker Casillas. Since opening our office in early 2019 with the founders plus 2... engineers, we have grown to 20+.

Our technology begins with video capture in the stadiums, detects player movements and actions, and delivers insights to coaches and players in the form of video clips with overlay illustrating high-level tactical concepts. Currently we are analyzing all the matches of La Liga but we need your help to scale to other markets and use cases!

This position is currently mixed remote/office at the discretion of each individual and each team. Most engineering roles come to the office less than once a month. Nevertheless, we prefer candidates in the Barcelona area or Spain more generally more administrative reasons but will consider international applications as well, within 1-2 time zones.

Responsibilities
• Work with engineering teams to improve the reliability, scalability, observability, and security of our technology systems.
• Advise teams and assist to improve CI/CD pipelines including deployments, release automation, etc.
• Identify and address possibilities for improvement in areas such as speed of delivery and infrastructure cost reduction.
• Develop and integrate new tools as needed to help manage Kognia’s technology stack.
• Improve Kognia’s cloud architecture and design new architectures as need arises.
• Spread a DevOps mindsets across the organization.
• Investigate new technologies and approaches as needed.
• Be on an on-call rotation to respond to service incidents.

Skills and qualifications

Required
• Proficiency with a programming language like Python (preferred) or Java.
• Proven experience working with SaaS production architectures in GCP (preferred) or AWS.
• Strong knowledge of Kubernetes and its ecosystem.
• Experience building CI/CD pipelines.
• Familiarity with security best practices.
• Interest in related topics such as scaling, SLOs, data engineering, etc.
• Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, changing agile environment.
• Willingness to wear multiple hats and evolve your responsibilities to meet the needs of the team.
• Excellent team player with strong verbal and written communication skills.
• Comfortable working in English - we’re an international team based in Barcelona, with English as our shared language.

Preferred
• Specific knowledge of GitLab CI/CD.
• Experience working with machine learning or other data processing pipelines in production.
• Experience managing remote IoT devices.
• Familiarity with Apache Kafka.

We welcome your application through this listing, or feel free to contact our CTO directly for any questions: henry.harrison@kogniasports.com

Kognia Sports Intelligence focuses on Sports, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, and Soccer. Their company has offices in Barcelona. They have a small team that's between 11-50 employees.

You can view their website at https://kogniasports.com

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
As a DevOps/Azure Cloud Engineer in our DevOps team, you will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure on the Azure platform. You will work closely with software development teams, ensuring the availability, scalability, and security of our applications and services. This role requires strong technical expertise in Azure, DevOps best practices, and a proactive mindset to drive continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:
• Design and deploy DevOps solutions on Azure cloud, leveraging tools like Azure DevOps, Kubernetes, Azure Functions, and Azure App Service;
• Collaborate with development, QA, and operations teams to automate build, test, and deployment workflows using Visual Studio, PowerShell, Git, and Azure CLI;
• Manage and optimize Azure cloud infrastructure, including virtual machines, storage accounts, networks, and security groups;
• Monitor and troubleshoot performance and availability of Azure applications using Azure Monitor... Application Insights, and Log Analytics;
• Advocate for DevOps best practices and foster a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement within the organization.

Why we would like to have a dialogue with you

We pick competencies over skills and experience. Can you convince us that you possess the following competencies:
• Proactiveness: The ability to anticipate and take initiative in addressing potential challenges or opportunities before they arise, demonstrating foresight and proactive problem-solving.
• Innovation: The ability to generate and implement new and innovative ideas to solve problems and create new business opportunities.
• Continuous learning & knowledge sharing: The ability and willingness to learn continuously throughout one's life, and to continuously seek out new knowledge and skills to stay up-to-date and relevant.
• Collaboration: The ability to work effectively with others and to build strong relationships based on trust and mutual respect, recognizing that everyone has something to contribute.
• Agile mindset: The ability to adapt quickly to changing circumstances, and to pivot or adjust strategies as needed to remain competitive and relevant.
• Systems thinking: The ability to understand the interdependencies and complexities of a business or project, and to develop integrated solutions that are scalable and adaptable to future changes.
• Adaptability: The ability to adjust to changing situations and work effectively in environments that may be uncertain or unpredictable.

Competencies are key, but to be successful in this role you need to bring a few essentials to kickstart the conversation:
• Azure cloud platform expertis
• DevOps automation proficiency
• Infrastructure management skills
• Knowledge of DevOps methodologies and tools (agile, CI/CD)
• Proficient in Microsoft technologies and tools, such as .NET Framework/Core, C#, ASP.NET MVC/Web API/Core, Entity Framework/Core, etc
• Several years of experience in software development and DevOps engineering

Some last notes

Hybrid or remote?

As we have a remote working policy in The Netherlands, we expect you to be at the office twice a week. In all the other countries, we have a remote working policy. As the location of this role is flexible (UK, ES or NL); it depends on the location of the role which benefits you'll enjoy. If you get invited for the first screening call with the recruiter, we are happy to tell you more about those.

Is chaos a bit of a guilty pleasure for you? Then be prepared for some excitement because no day is the same at Anywhere365 and enjoy the ride. These difficult roads will substantially add value to your development and work experience because they often lead to beautiful destinations!

But the real reason to choose us? You get the opportunity to experience what it's like to work with proud, smart, devoted and cooperative colleagues who are passionate about our dialogue products and Microsoft technology. Just like you, they go the extra mile to deliver top-notch solutions. If this sounds like what you’re looking for to find in a team, then we definitely tick that box!

Anywhere365 is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We accept difference and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community.

Please note that we have a background check policy. The background check differs per country and position. If you would like to know more, the recruiters are happy to answer any questions

jobs_results.title: Digital Platform Azure DevOps Lead
jobs_results.via: via Careers At Mars - Mars, Incorporated
jobs_results.description:
Job Description:

Petcare Growth Digital Platform team is in search of an experienced Azure DevOps Lead Engineer to oversee the implementation and management of DevOps practices and tools within our GDP Azure environment. This role will require a combination of technical expertise, leadership skills, and a deep understanding of DevOps principles and Azure technologies. This role will operate at a global level and will have to coordinate the Products development teams using the Azure platform.

What are we looking for?
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Proven experience and strong proficiency as an Azure DevOps lead in a multi products multinational environment.
• Azure infrastructure and Services: very familiar with Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Container Instances, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL Database, and other Azure services used in DevOps workflows.
• Excellent... problem-solving mindset with attention to detail.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Leadership and mentoring abilities.
• Continuous Learning and Improvement.
• Leadership and Team Management: this role may require to run a 2-3 DevOps engineer team over time.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.
What will be your key responsibilities?
• DevOps Strategy Development: He/She collaborates with key stakeholders to develop and refine the organization's DevOps strategy, including defining goals, objectives, and metrics for success. He/She also assesses the current state of DevOps practices and identifies areas for improvement.
• Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Proficiency in designing, implementing, and managing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps Services or Azure DevOps Server. This includes defining build and release processes, automating testing, and deploying applications to Azure environments.
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with infrastructure automation using tools like Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, Terraform, or Azure DevTest Labs. He/She should be able to set up monitoring solutions to track the performance, availability, and health of Azure resources and applications.
• Security and Compliance: Understanding of security best practices fir Azure environments, including identity and access management (IAM), network security, encryption, and compliance standards such as GDPR, HIPAA, and SOC. He/She should ensure that DevOps processes and infrastructure are designed and implemented with security in mind (DevSecOps)
• Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, Bash for automating tasks and managing Azure resources programmatically. He/She should be able to write scripts to automate deployment, configuration, and maintenance tasks.

What can you expect from Mars?
• Work with over 130,000 diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
• Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
• Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
• An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

Mars is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request
